card.title: 740th RIFLE REGIMENT
card.text: Deployment: Develop ARCTIC CONVOY, BURNING SKY or THE HAMMER.
card.flavorText: The 740th Rifle Regiment was part of the Soviet Union’s 217th Rifle Division, an infantry unit formed just months before the German invasion in 1941. Created at Voronezh, the division saw early action under 28th Army, then 50th Army, narrowly avoiding destruction during Operation Typhoon. It played a key role in the defense of Tula where it endured heavy losses, with one regiment replaced by a local militia unit. After months of holding defensive positions, the 217th joined the 11th Guards Army and advanced westward during Operation Kutuzov in 1943. It later earned the Order of the Red Banner for its contribution to the battle for Gomel. During Operation Bagration in 1944, it helped liberate Zhlobin and Bobruisk. The division then participated in the Vistula-Oder Offensive, capturing Mława and pushing into East Prussia. For these achievements, it received the Order of Lenin and the Order of Suvorov. By war’s end, the 217th was engaged in the East Prussian campaign, finishing near Königsberg.
